title: Explicit Picard comparisons and transpose-square assembly
statement: Let h:T→W be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], P_h its tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], N,D O_W-modules and N_T,D_T O_T-modules. Use the tensor and unit comparisons transported from ordinary pullback [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map]. Define δ_N:P_h(N^∨)→(P_hN)^∨ by transposing the pulled internal-Hom evaluation. For φ:D→N^∨, ψ:D_T→N_T^∨, c:P_hN→N_T and a:P_hD→D_T, assume c,a,δ_N are invertible and (c⊗a) followed by uncurry ψ equals the pulled pairing uncurry φ with the tensor and unit comparisons. Then the isomorphisms associated to a and δ_N followed by the inverse dual of c give a commuting square P_hφ followed by b equals a followed by ψ. The module also fixes the tensor-composition comparison, the canonical map v:X_T→X_W, and the direct-image base-change map β_M by composing the adjoint-defined map [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] with the top tensor-composition comparison.

proof.text: Construct the tensor-composition comparison from picardTensorComparison, ordinary pullbackComp and the equality of the top composite. Construct v by pullback.lift and β_M as the actual mate followed by pushforward of this comparison. Define δ_N as curry of pulled internal-Hom evaluation. No data are chosen from mere existence.

Prove inverse tensor-comparison naturality by naturality of picardTensorComparison and Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural. Use uncurry_natural_left and uncurry_curry to show uncurry(P_hφ followed by δ_N) is exactly the pulled pairing.

Use pre_app and uncurry_pre_app to prove that the transpose of (c⊗a) followed by the target pairing is a followed by ψ followed by dualMap c. Apply uncurry_injective to the assumed pairing equality. Compose with the inverse dual isomorphism of c and cancel its inverse followed by its hom. This constructs the requested square.

theorem picardBaseChangeSquare_of_pairings {W T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ W)
    (N D : W.Modules) (NT DT : T.Modules)
    (φ : D ⟶ dual N) (ψ : DT ⟶ dual NT)
    (c : (tensorPullback h).obj N ⟶ NT) (a : (tensorPullback h).obj D ⟶ DT)
    [IsIso c] [IsIso a] [IsIso (picardTensorDualComparison h N)]
    (hpair : (c ⊗ₘ a) ≫ MonoidalClosed.uncurry ψ =
      (picardTensorObjIso h N D).inv ≫ (tensorPullback h).map (MonoidalClosed.uncurry φ) ≫
        (picardTensorUnitIso h).hom) :
    ∃ (aI : (tensorPullback h).obj D ≅ DT)
      (bI : (tensorPullback h).obj (dual N) ≅ dual NT),
      (tensorPullback h).map φ ≫ bI.hom = aI.hom ≫ ψ
